anya: quick heads-up — trying to merge two sample banks (sparse-rare-intent & recent-scratch-aug) into a single mergeflow. counts: sparse=43k, scratch=12k. hit rate on current holdouts looks low for the sparse bucket. thinking: consolidate by intent cluster then relabel 5% golden. anyone object?

milan: no objection. main risk is fingerprint collisions across banks — did we regenerate tokenhashes after tokenizer v2 rollout?

anya: good point. tokenizer v2 went live last week. regenerated hashes for scratch but NOT for sparse. we should run a rehash + dedupe pass before we merge.

samir: I can run a fast embed dedupe. propose pipeline:
1) normalize text (unicode nfkc, lowercase, remove leading/trailing whitespace)
2) embed with model q4b-16k
3) cluster with hdbscan (min_cluster_size=5, cluster_selection_epsilon=0.15)
4) within cluster run md5 on normalized text, drop exact duplicates and keep highest-quality sample per cluster
command to run: 
```python tools/dedupe_bank.py --input s3://redwood/banks/sparse-bank.jsonl \
  --embed-model q4b-16k --threshold 0.85 \
  --tokenizer-version tokenizer-v2 \
  --out s3://redwood/tmp/sparse-clean.jsonl
```
lemme run tonight, will post a 100-sample cluster dump for review.

ingest-bot: ingest event: last ingest for sparse-bank at 1763200000, new items pending=3,100. /ingest status -> pending

labeling-svc: capacity check — current label queue backlog=2,100. active labelers=12 (weekend shift). throughput ~400/day if prioritized. golden relabel 5% of combined ~2.75k -> ~138 tasks, we can finish in ~2 days with overtime.

tara: agree to the 5% golden relabel. also recommend holdout split change: keep 10% of sparse untouched for final smoke tests, and 2% of scratch. add two adversarial prompts per sample for calibration (small templates attached).

milan: one more thought on future-proofing: if we switch embedding model later the clusters will change. keep strict provenance metadata per sample: embed_model, tokenizer_version, pool_id, ingest_ts. add these to schema now so downstream evals are reproducible.

anya: updated schema patch suggestion: `provenance.embed_model=q4b-16k; provenance.tokenizer=tokenizer-v2; provenance.pool=mergeflow-2026-03` — and we should store original_bank_id + original_id.

samir: dry-run started (embedding 43k -> 12k after coarse cluster prune predicted). I'll upload `sparse-dedupe-sample-100.jsonl` to the shared folder when done (ETA ~12h). early checks for md5 collisions included.

ops-bot: note: routing policy for labeler credits — if labeling backlog > 2000, auto-scale labeler credits by 1.5x. current backlog triggers no-change until new dedupe results post-merge.

anya: next steps recap:
- @samir: run dedupe + post 100-sample cluster dump (ETA: 12h)
- @labeling-svc: reserve 200 golden slots, prioritize merged pool relabels
- @milan: add provenance fields to ingest schema and ensure tokenhash regen path (ETA: EOD)
- @tara: prepare holdout/adversarial template and share two example prompts

anya: pinging @samir and @milan for status tomorrow morning :eyes:

labeling-svc: acknowledged. :thumbsup:
